final: WITH c AS (SELECT t.tradekind AS k, COUNT(*) AS n FROM advancedbehavior a JOIN transactionrecord r ON r.transreg = a.translink JOIN trader t ON t.tradereg = r.trdref GROUP BY t.tradekind), s AS (SELECT SUM(n) AS tot, AVG(n) AS av FROM c) SELECT SUM(c.n) AS sum_counts, AVG(c.n * 1.0 / s.tot) AS avg_share, AVG(c.n - s.av) AS avg_excess FROM c, s WHERE c.n > s.av
